name: Tasuki Ekiden
description: Tasuki Ekiden — a community ekiden relay race theme with a formal top header: the race name centred on the top row, the Enter a team button at its right end and the menu centred on its own row beneath. Konpeki blue (#007BBB) is the main colour: the hero text half, the course strip, the sash band, every page head and the overlay menu are konpeki fields with a sumi-ink wind-and-wave brush pattern multiplied in, set in white. The hero puts the text on the left and a framed sumi-ink painting of a sash handover on the right; a cut-out runner breaks out of the frame across the blue field and over the hero bottom edge. Horizontal strips: the five legs of the course scroll sideways as one strip of cards, race day runs as a four-step strip, and the race board is one long band. A cut-out blue sash breaks over the sash band. Every picture is a sumi-ink brush painting with cerulean washes. Rampart One for display, Archivo for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-1 (horizontal-strip, text-left-art-right hero, centered nav, full-illustration, sumi-ink, konpeki #007BBB, Rampart One + Archivo, events-community). A formal top header: the race name centred on the top row with the Enter a team button at its right end and the menu centred on its own row beneath (overlay menu on phones and tablets). Horizontal strips: the course legs scroll sideways as one strip of cards, race day is a four-step strip, the race board one long band. Every picture is a sumi-ink brush painting. Break-frame: the cut-out runner (transparent WebP) breaks out of the framed hero painting, across the konpeki field and over the hero bottom edge into the race board; the cut-out blue sash breaks over the sash band's top edge and its framed painting; the runner breaks over the bottom edge of every page head. Traditional Chinese headings use a bundled Noto Sans TC Bold subset (gothic, the closest to the heavy Rampart One).

fonts.role: display: hero type, headings, the race name and numbers (Regular; a Latin subset and a Japanese subset of the Japanese sample text)
display for Traditional Chinese pages (Bold, subset to the characters of the zh-TW sample text; never a Japanese font)

summary.en: A konpeki-blue coastal ekiden: text left, sumi-ink art right, a cut-out runner breaking out and the course as a sideways strip.
summary.ja: 紺碧の海辺の駅伝。文字は左、水墨画は右、枠を飛び出す切り抜きのランナー、横に流れる五区間。五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Un ekiden côtier bleu konpeki : texte à gauche, encre sumi à droite, coureur détouré qui déborde, parcours en bande.
summary.de: Ein konpekiblaues Küsten-Ekiden: Text links, Tuschemalerei rechts, ein freigestellter Läufer bricht aus, Strecke als Band.
